_comment: NEPSE trading calendar. Trading days are Monday-Friday (Sunday declared a government holiday; schedule changed from Sun-Thu to Mon-Fri per owner, 2026-10-01). NEPSE follows Nepal government public holidays. EVERY Oct-Dec 2026 entry is marked status=unverified — dates were assembled from public lists, NOT verified against an official NEPSE/government notice; the owner will supply official holiday notices. Lunar-calendar festival dates shift yearly — refresh this file each January and verify Dashain/Tihar dates against the official notice. Missing-holiday handling: if the market-close pipeline finds no new session after the final retry, the day is treated as market closed and a low-priority [NEPSE NOTICE] email is sent (never a failure alert).

2027._todo: Populate each January from the official Nepal government holiday notice. Lunar dates below are NOT yet verified for 2027 - do not guess.

weekly_note: 1=Monday .. 7=Sunday. Saturday and Sunday are non-trading days.
